
# Git Commit Instructions

When generating Git commit messages, follow these rules:

- Write all commit messages in English.
- Use Conventional Commits.
- The first line must contain no more than 50 characters.
- Use the format: type(scope): description
- Use the imperative mood.
- Leave the second line empty.
- Starting on the third line, describe the changes in detail.
- Explain what was changed and why.
- Use bullet points for multiple changes.
- Do not use emojis.
- Do not invent changes that are not present.

Allowed types:
- feat: New feature
- fix: Bug fix
- refactor: Code restructuring
- docs: Documentation
- style: Formatting
- test: Tests
- chore: Maintenance
- perf: Performance improvement
